gap: At the flash peak the canvas is a flat, colourless white-to-grey radial (centre 255,255,253, corners neutral grey 181,181,179, no wall detail, no warm bloom) while the name, note, chips and chrome stay at full contrast on top (identical ink values before, during and after), so it reads as the WebGL canvas going blank rather than a warm camera flash blowing out the whole scene.
notes: 1) The flash caption (four sittings, one strip: ..., 13 words) is written straight across the gators dc polaroid and its caption from ~2.67 to 3.1 vh and still ghosts over that photo in the taped state; put it on clear wall and fade it out fully before taped. 2) Countdown 3/1 and smile! sit ~100-150 px right of the photo-corner slot centre, so the numerals clip the halftone photo and the URIIS note and smile! covers URIIS 2026; centre them in the slot. 3) Strip swing barely reads: it drops straight in from the top edge (top cropped) and only tilts ~3 deg to ~2 deg, no visible overshoot or settle. 4) While developing, the photo corners peek out from under the strip left edge as dark slivers, then sit on top by 3.3 (layer pop); the tape is cream on a cream border and nearly invisible, so the tape-lands-with-a-press beat does not register. 5) Good: numerals are big riso pink with blue offset, frames develop top to bottom one after another (ghost at 2.25, all four by 2.88), recovery is smooth (milky cream veil at 2.05, clean by 2.25), taped composition is close to the bar apart from the caption ghost. No console errors or failed chapters.
